subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the day after the Underdark, when rest was a luxury good and rarely in stock.
source_quote: the kind that had felt almost suspicious after the Underdark, where a full night's sleep had been a luxury good and rarely in stock

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: The window was narrowing with every minute we spent in this room

subject: glabbagool count
fact: Glabbagool, with two eyeballs tracking the room, is present in the corner after developing attentiveness since acquiring eyes.
source_quote: Glabbagool had been watching from the corner with the patient attentiveness he'd developed since acquiring eyes... and peered out from the opening with two eyeballs tracking the room

subject: travel to the emerald door
fact: The emerald door is the threshold beyond which danger awaits, and we are not walking into it depleted.
source_quote: Whatever was waiting through the emerald door, we weren't walking into it depleted

subject: Candlekeep grounds elevation
fact: Candlekeep's grounds are blanketed in snow, silent and untouched, after months below stone.
source_quote: Candlekeep's grounds were blanketed in it, white and silent, the kind of silence that had nothing hunting inside it

subject: Astronomicon value
fact: The Astronomicon is a stack of blue globes ascending in scale, containing everything known about the stars.
source_quote: You see that curious blue stack of globes? That's the Astronomicon. Everything we know about the stars can be found there

subject: Whispering Dome value
fact: The Whispering Dome holds voices from the past that linger and can be heard if one stands in the right place.
source_quote: voices from the past lingered there, that you could hear them if you stood in the right place

subject: Drakonoikos elevation
fact: Drakonoikos is a structure built from enormous scales and bones worked into the walls, replacing stone.
source_quote: The structure was built from scales — actual scales, enormous, overlapping — and bones worked into the walls where another building would have used stone

subject: Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber incident
fact: One of the Avowed died in the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber, requiring Keeper's permission for access.
source_quote: One of the Avowed had died in it, he said, which was why the Keeper's permission was now required

subject: Chapter House entrance
fact: The Chapter House has a single guard, single visible point of entry, and no secondary exit apparent from the doorway.
source_quote: single guard, single visible point of entry, no secondary exit apparent from the doorway

subject: Council of Twelve meeting
fact: The Council of Twelve convened in uproar over Janussi's murder, with twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table and a rose window casting colored light.
source_quote: twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table, rose window throwing colored light across the stone floor

subject: Dawnbringer value
fact: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, claims to have been found in a tomb after two thousand years.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, took the opportunity to note that we must surely be the greatest discoverers of all, having found her tomb after two thousand years

subject: library access card value
fact: An all-access library card was requested and granted as part of the investigation agreement, allowing full access to the library.
source_quote: We need an all-access library card... Bookwyrm agreed. One book each, copied at the House of the Binder, upon successful completion. Confidentiality papers first

subject: Crime Scene staircase
fact: The staircase to the crime scene is narrow, requiring single file passage, with Bookwyrm setting the pace.
source_quote: The staircase was narrow enough that we had to go single file, which meant Bookwyrm set the pace

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's arrival
fact: Kalan Strongbranch arrived at the Chapter House after being previously wanted for questioning, and bowed with correct form but suspicious eyes.
source_quote: Kalan Strongbranch walked in... He bowed. The bow was correct and the eyes were not

subject: Janussi's resignation request
fact: Janussi asked Kalan to tender his resignation the morning before his death, citing loss of mental faculties and negligence.
source_quote: yesterday morning, Janussi asked the gate warden to tender his resignation. The Keeper was concerned that Kalan was losing his mental faculties and becoming negligent in his work

subject: Bookwyrm's testimony
fact: Bookwyrm disclosed that Janussi requested Kalan’s resignation, but declined to elaborate, claiming not to prejudice the investigation.
source_quote: Janussi, the morning before his death, had asked Kalan to tender his resignation. Mental faculties. Negligence. She declined to elaborate — she didn't want to prejudice the investigation, she said

subject: Thorin's question to Bookwyrm
fact: Thorin asked Bookwyrm where she was during Janussi’s death, prompting a pause and visible weight in her expression.
source_quote: Thorin, immediate: 'Where were you?' Bookwyrm paused. Not a long pause. Just long enough to weigh something.
